feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Combat Celebrant.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Proceed to your combat step.
Declare the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
Cast Boros Charm by paying {R}{W}, giving permanents you control indestructible until end of turn.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 4 any number of times.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Loyal Apprentice triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

card.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
card.typeLine: Enchantment — Saga // Enchantment Creature — Goblin Shaman

template.name: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

almostIncluded.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker and exert it, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an extra combat.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Combat Celebrant by tapping it, making a token copy of itself with haste.
Proceed to your combat step.
Declare the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Combat Celebrant.
Combat Celebrant does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Mirage Phalanx and Combat Celebrant each trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and without soulbond.
The Mirage Phalanx token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Mirage Phalanx token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger from step 1, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, allowing you to exert it to untap all other creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Combat Celebrant.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Impact Tremors triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Declare Arabella as an attacker.
Arabella triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of creatures you control with power 2 or less, and causing you to gain life equal to that same number.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Arabella does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.notes: This combo can deal twice as much damage if you pay Agate Instigator's offspring cost to control two of them.
almostIncluded.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Agate Instigator triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

almostIncluded.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher as attackers, choosing to exert Sandstorm Crasher and Combat Celebrant as they attack. Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher each trigger.
Resolve the Sandstorm Crasher trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase using the Combat Celebrant token instead.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: Sandstorm Crasher does not have summoning sickness.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. The token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{R}.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Sun Titan, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Sun Titan when you attack.
Sun Titan does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Idol of Oblivion by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Idol of Oblivion.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: You've created a token this turn.

feature.name: Near-infinite creature tokens that are tapped and attacking

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Adeline trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Mondrak attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Adeline trigger, creating 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) 1/1 Human creature tokens tapped and attacking each opponent.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Declare Cephalid Illusionist as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Reconnaissance by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Reconnaissance abilities.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Illusionist does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Secure the Wastes by paying {5}{W}, creating five 1/1 Warrior creature tokens.
When the Warriors enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Grand Crescendo by paying {5}{W}{W}, creating five 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
When the Citizens enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

Attack with Cephalid Aristocrat.
Pay {0} to Reconnaissance targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Mill 2.
With the trigger on the stack, repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Aristocrat does not have summoning sickness.
